sloka: विश्वकर्मवचः श्रुत्वा ततस्ते राक्षसोत्तमाः ।सहस्रानुचरा भूत्वा गत्वा तामवसन्पुरीम् ।। ७.५.२९ ॥
transliteration: viśvakarmavacaḥ śrutvā tataste rākṣasottamāḥ ।sahasrānucarā bhūtvā gatvā tāmavasanpurīm ।। 7.5.29 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Vishwakarma, those foremost Rakshasas then went to that city with thousands of followers and dwelt there.
